content: rmcp crate (official MCP Rust SDK) is the right choice: supports HTTP+SSE and stdio transports, uses tokio, has #[tool_router] and #[tool] macros for defining handlers as async methods returning Result<CallToolResult, McpError>. Embed in Tauri by spawning the MCP server on a tokio task sharing AppHandle. Tool handlers that need to block-until-child-exits simply .await the child's exit future — tokio cooperatively yields so other pty streams remain alive. Concurrent spawn_agent calls from one parent are handled naturally: each call spawns a tokio::task for that child.
